categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Eastern Shenghong Co., Ltd. operates primarily in petrochemical refining, chemical new materials, and polyester fiber manufacturing. The company has a vertically integrated industrial chain covering oil refining, chemical raw materials, and downstream polyester fiber products. It also engages in energy production, including power and heat supply, and has diversified into new energy and advanced materials sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced refining technologies including atmospheric and vacuum distillation, delayed coking, hydrocracking, and catalytic reforming. It operates large-scale integrated refining and chemical production facilities, including a 16 million ton/year refining complex and methanol-to-olefins (MTO) and propane dehydrogenation (PDH) units. In polyester fiber production, it employs melt spinning and chip spinning processes, with proprietary technologies in differentiated and functional fibers, as well as recycling technologies for regenerated polyester fibers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Eastern Shenghong serves a broad range of industries including textiles, automotive, electronics, construction, and renewable energy sectors. Its polyester fibers are used in apparel, home textiles, and industrial applications. The company supplies chemical raw materials to downstream manufacturers of plastics, synthetic fibers, and specialty chemicals. It also caters to domestic and international markets, with exports to over 30 countries including South Korea, Turkey, Vietnam, Pakistan, and Italy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in China, with major production facilities located in Suzhou and Lianyungang, Jiangsu Province. It benefits from strategic positioning in the Lianyungang Petrochemical Industrial Base, one of China's seven major petrochemical hubs. The company also has overseas subsidiaries in Singapore and exports products globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Eastern Shenghong operates across the upstream, midstream, and downstream segments of the petrochemical and polyester fiber supply chain. It controls upstream refining and chemical raw material production, midstream chemical processing, and downstream polyester fiber manufacturing, enabling integrated supply chain management and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in new energy materials, high-performance fibers, and green low-carbon technologies. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on AI integration for smart manufacturing, carbon capture and utilization, and development of differentiated functional fibers. The '1+N' strategy aims to build a core raw material platform plus diversified new energy, new materials, electronic chemicals, and biotechnology chains.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of petrochemical products, chemical new materials, and polyester fibers. The company employs a direct sales model with long-term contracts for large customers and spot sales for smaller clients. It also earns income from energy sales and property leasing. Payments are generally received before shipment, with some credit extended to trusted customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Eastern Shenghong is one of China's leading private petrochemical refining enterprises and a top player in chemical new materials and polyester fiber sectors. It holds industry-leading capacities in acrylonitrile, EVA, and polyester fibers, and is recognized for its technological innovation and integrated industrial chain. Competitors include other large state-owned and private petrochemical and fiber manufacturers in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 137.7 billion RMB, a slight decrease from the previous year. It experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 2.3 billion RMB, impacted by volatile raw material prices and market demand. Total assets reached over 204 billion RMB, with steady growth in asset base and cash flow from operations. The company continues to invest significantly in capacity expansion and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Eastern Shenghong differentiates itself through its fully integrated petrochemical and polyester fiber production chain, advanced technology platforms, and focus on high-value, differentiated products such as functional fibers and green recycled polyester. Its scale advantages, proprietary technologies in new energy materials, and commitment to sustainability and AI-driven smart manufacturing provide competitive cost and quality advantages, meeting evolving customer demands for high-performance and environmentally friendly products.
